notes.title: Halloween Update: Possessed Pumpkin Tournament
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/68a5fdc4655b355531ee8f02c9aeadb50f103698.png

We’re celebrating Halloween with a shadowy new update that was inspired by community feature requests. Enter if you dare!

1. The Dojo has had an eerie visual makeover and has been haunted with creepy new sound effects.

2. A limited edition Halloween Leaderboard with the “soul task” of keeping count of how many Possessed Pumpkins each ninja around the world dissects.

3. The first rare Bat Blade is here! The top 400 soul releasers on the Possessed Pumpkin Leaderboard will win this wieldable blade and find it waiting for them on their new personal Blade Stand once the tournament has ended. Players will discover they can release souls by dissecting pumpkins in game.

The Tournament starts now and will end Mon, 07 Nov 2016 00:00:00 GMT. Happy Halloween and have fun!

notes.title: New Update: Survival Mode
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/ef15fae5416a48a0f37f919961cddda143b3fbef.pngSensei is calling in air support!

Step into the firing line and face off against flying cannons in the hardest Fruit Ninja mode to date. You won’t find this challenge in any other version of the game!

This release puts a fresh twist on Classic Mode by introducing flying enemies that are constantly on the move. Better yet: the longer you survive, the more cannons you’ll face!

Are you ready to dodge, duck, dip, dice and dodge? Unsheathe your blades and show us what you’re made of!

notes.title: New Update: Local Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Winning isn’t everything, it’s the only thing! This update introduces local leaderboards so you can finally settle the score with friends, family, and your closest rivals. We’re also working on a brand new game mode which is expected to drop soon. Watch this space for details!

To change your leaderboard settings:

1. Navigate to the main menu of the game
2. Press the menu button on your controller
3. Select "Settings" and then "Leaderboards"
4. Choose your preferred leaderboard type

We plan on changing how the leaderboards are displayed (and the settings menu) in the near future, so this process will improve as development progresses. Keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Peachy Time Update
notes.notes:
We're happy to introduce the Peachy Time update!

Peachy Time is now available in Arcade and Zen Mode. Peaches will be thrown into the mix of fruit for you to slice and dice. Each time you slice a peach, it will add an extra 2 seconds to your timer.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/4b9a53f502c8ce17d79027f744181dd53bc3aa4e.png

You can now access the quality settings via the menu button while in the main menu of the game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/c9d7c1361ef7a27064cccdf1a5f417e492415ee1.png

We also tweaked the position of the side fruit pillars in Arcade mode.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/e9d96d549f40993f655bb0ee51fdc21fb81ab7bb.png

And tweaked the blitz bananas to come more frequently depending on how well you are performing in Arcade mode as well.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/dd14277b8a0d512b34f04067491ea0d5b60f8cfb.png

There's heaps more to come so please keep on playing, and keep discussing the game in the community hub!

notes.title: Day 1 Performance Patch
notes.notes:
This fixes some jittering in the fruit and bomb movement that we believe people were reporting as frame rate issues.

We have also fixed a visual bug with the bomb explosion.

We hope you all enjoy the update and please keep the information and ideas coming.
